meta.rule: bias-subtracted plurality: argmax_v [N_v / k - A(v)], A(v) = sum_c mu_c mu_{c+v} (2-query vote) or the law of o1 - o2 - o3 + o4 (4-query mul vote); tie = failure

D1.definition: frac = fraction of ALL inputs of G that are correctable (exp_channels convention; x = 0 and, for mul, the 61 inputs with a = 0 or b = 0 are trivially correctable under both rules); frac_nontrivial excludes them (exp_tasks convention for mul, the pilot's convention for add/lin).  eps bins [lo, hi) of width 0.1 over models with eps > 0 (last bin closed).  harmed input = plain-correctable but not debias-correctable; helped = the reverse.

add/memo|p=53.note: add/memo runs have ONE snapshot each

competitor_at_uncorrectable_inputs.definition: share of uncorrectable inputs with f(x) != 0 whose strongest competitor (largest plain mass, resp. largest debiased score) is the zero vote M(x+r) = M(r), offset -f(x); median over models

representatives.why: lowest-eps add/grok snapshot with an uncorrectable input (results/exp_channels.json A5)

D2.selection_rule: add/grok p = 47: for each target eps in [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.65, 0.75] the snapshot with the smallest |eps - target| among the runs with split_seed = init_seed = 0 (ties: lower train_frac, then earlier step); if none lies within 0.03 of the target, the closest over all seeds (the rule of exp_channels A4).  Plus addgrok_p23_f0.5_ss1_is1_t00036.
D2.definition: failure = the rule does not return f(x) uniquely (a tie for first place is a failure). mean = mean over ALL inputs of G; worst = max over inputs.  exact = generating-function recursion with per-input thresholds (all inputs for k <= 65, and for every k when |G| <= 600; for p = 47 at k = 129 only on a candidate set: the 25 highest-failure inputs of each rule at k = 65 and in the k = 129 Monte Carlo, plus the 25 smallest asymptotic margins of each rule).  Exact values below 1e-10 are at the accuracy floor and flagged unreliable. mc = paired Monte Carlo from the exact channel (both rules on the same multinomial vote counts), 1000 samples per input (4000 when |G| <= 600); se = standard error of the mean over inputs; when no failure is observed, mc_upper95 = 3 / (samples x inputs).  chernoff = union-of-Chernoff upper bound (rigorous).  real = actual votes on the table (core.sc_votes), 100 trials per input, both rules on the same votes; z against the exact mean.  frac_inputs_delta_neg = share of inputs where some delta_x(h) < 0 (harm possible at this k); frac_inputs_delta_pos = share where some delta_x(h) > 0 (help possible).

D3.definition: mu is estimated from the network's outputs on n inputs drawn uniformly WITH replacement from G (no labels).  plug-in: A(v) = sum_c m_c m_{c+v} / n^2 (m_c = sample counts), the rule as stated; unbiased: self-pairs removed, A(0) = sum_c m_c (m_c - 1) / (n (n - 1)).  The plug-in A(0) is biased upwards by about 1/n.  'gain retained' = (frac_est - frac_plain) / (frac_exact_mu - frac_plain) where the denominator is > 0.

config.construction: identical to theory_checks section_c4 (rng = default_rng(seed); U = rng.random(n); V = rng.integers(1, p, n)); the two 'collapse' families are new here

incoherent.definition: e(x) = V(x) 1[U(x) < eps], V uniform on H \ {0} (scattered values)

offset.definition: e(x) = 1[U(x) < eps] (constant offset on a random set)

second_hom.definition: M = g = a + 2b on a random set of density eps, f elsewhere

collapse_random.definition: M = 0 on a random set of density eps (the zero-vote mechanism in pure form)

band_odd.definition: e(a,b) = 1 for a < m (constant-offset band, theory_checks band_odd)

collapse_band.definition: M = 0 for a < m, M = f elsewhere (constructed harm case)

harm_case.construction: G = Z_31^2, f = a + b, the network answers 0 on the band a < 15 and f elsewhere.  Errors are the inputs of the band with f(x) != 0.
harm_case.why: For x with f(x) = 0 the truth IS the zero vote.  The rule subtracts A(0) = sum mu^2, the collision rate of two INDEPENDENT outputs; but for x = (x1, -x1) with x1 far from 0 the pair (r, x + r) is rarely inside the band together, so the actual zero-vote mass is far below A(0) and the truth is over-penalised.

family_statistics.definition: out_collision_times_q = q sum_c mu_c^2 (1 = balanced outputs; for mul the 2-query value); bg_A0_minus_minA_times_q = q (A(0) - min_v A(v)) (the largest penalty difference the rule can apply, in units of 1/q); at plain-uncorrectable inputs with f(x) != 0: deficit = T_x(h*) - T_x(0) (h* = strongest wrong value), correction = A(f(x)+h*) - A(f(x)) (what the rule adds to the truth relative to h*); medians over inputs, then over models

D5.procedure: theory_checks C3 grid (step 0.04 from 0.20, then 0.008, then 0.002; last passing grid point, realised error rate), nested i.i.d. fields e = V 1[U < eps], seeds 7000 + 100 p + s, s < 24; each rule searched separately on the same fields
